facts.fact: The StackAdapt and LiveRamp 1st-Party Data Measurement partnership is offered to clients in the US.
facts.quote: This partnership enables clients in the US to improve the effectiveness of their ad spend and uncover total return on investment from StackAdapt campaigns on offline conversions.

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, client offline conversion data is matched to online campaigns mid- or post-campaign, and client-owned data is anonymized through LiveRamp before being shared with StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Through LiveRamp, client owned data is anonymized to protect consumer privacy, prior to sharing with StackAdapt.

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, clients can access enhanced metrics for accurate reach, customer penetration percentage, and frequency data through the 1st-Party Data Measurement solution.
facts.quote: From StackAdapt, clients can access enhanced metrics showing accurate reach, customer penetration percentage, and frequency data.

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, offline event data for the 1st-Party Data Measurement solution can be derived from sources including voters and in-store sales.
facts.quote: Offline event data can be derived from a variety of sources, including voters and in-store sales.
